lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps and changing finish layouts consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption new screens proved helpful by producing winning tests with consistent positive direction.
Adoption copy, home redesign, home wait-info, sign-in hints, and sign-in redesign showed no clear effect across tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, though pessimistic negative predictions were too low for winning tests.

Evidence remains thin for kinds of change tested only once or without clear agreement across tests (such as adoption hint, adoption new_flow, choose_path layout, finish copy, finish incentive, finish new_flow, finish notification, home new_flow, and home new_screen).

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in steps and changing finish layouts consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption new screens proved helpful, producing a winning test with consistent positive direction.
Adoption new flows consistently hurt performance across multiple tests.
Home wait-info and adoption copy showed no clear effect, producing no winning tests despite wait-info leaning positive.
Evidence remains thin for changes tested only once or lacking clear agreement across tests (such as redesigns, hints, and layout variations outside finish).
Predictions were generally too high for failing tests, while negative predictions were too low for winning tests.
